prompt_lines: Asset type: Stage 2 brand-mood commercial food photograph, strict frontal anchor

Primary request: Edit the base image so the same maker performs a careful final visual inspection of the alignment and adhesion of minimal black direct print on one already-filled and already-foil-sealed transparent low-wide yogurt cup. Change only the cup, her minimal hand-to-cup contact as needed, and remove all loose packaging parts from the foreground.

Identity and scene invariants: Preserve the exact same adult woman—face, facial proportions, skin texture, freckles, hair, hairline, expression, downward gaze, charcoal T-shirt, charcoal apron, body scale and centered pose. Preserve the strict 0-degree frontal camera, 3:2 horizontal framing, table edges, wall, diagonal daylight, stainless furniture, idle cup sealer at frame right, small closed metal scale at rear left, exposure, color grade and shadows. Do not redesign or beautify the person or room.

Package: One transparent food-contact polymer yogurt cup, clearly a low-wide tapered yogurt cup about 1.55:1 diameter-to-height, wide molded rim/flange, modest stable foot, filled with dense ivory yogurt visible through the clear wall. A flat full-perimeter low-glare foil is already sealed to the rim with one asymmetric pull tab. No paper component of any kind. The cup exterior has minimal neutral-black direct print with no backing panel.

Action: Keep the maker looking down at the cup. One hand lightly steadies the cup at its clear side/base and the other lightly indexes the opposite side, visually checking that the front print is centered, adhered and clear relative to fill and foil edge. This is inspection only: no printing, labeling, sleeving, sealing, filling, coding, wiping or peeling.

Text verbatim: MORA as a quiet small first line and THYME HONEY as the larger recipe line, crisp neutral black directly on the transparent cup wall. No other legible text, numbers, dates, barcodes or marks.

Material and optics: Make the clear molded polymer unmistakable but restrained—plausible sidewall thickness, rim double edge, food fill and one broad white reflection plus narrow dark edge; no glass brilliance or cosmetic gloss. The black print sits on the outside of the clear wall without white underprint or opaque/frosted panel. Yogurt is the natural pale background behind the text. Foil is thin, flat, low-glare and continuously sealed.

Remove completely: the white fiber collar/sleeve around the cup, its window cutouts and seam, the loose paper ring/collar at lower left, the loose round lid/foil disk at lower center, every label, paper card, paper scrap and spare packaging part on the table.

Constraints: Absolutely no individual paper label, sleeve, collar, adhesive sticker, loose paper ring, frosted label illusion, colored ink or flavor marker. No printer head, roller, screen, pad, label applicator, registration numbers, gauge, invented mechanism or claimed SOP. No amber bottle, apothecary grid, labware, cosmetic jar, perfume bottle, kraft, wood, twine, rustic styling, text elsewhere or watermark. Preserve photoreal commercial-editorial realism, hand anatomy and real contact shadows.

Preserve every other visual element exactly: same woman and facial identity, one-eye strict 90-degree side profile, hair, skin, clothes, gaze, pose, hands and contacts, cup shape and position, transparent wall, yogurt fill, sealed foil and tab, stainless table and sealer, wall, diagonal daylight, camera, crop, exposure, shadows and color grade.
